about_the_game:
Angels vs. Angels is a unique multiplayer shooter where self-aware AI factions wage war over humanity's digitized souls in dynamically dissolving, ethereal battlegrounds.

In this enthralling adventure, angels must ascend the crystals to the heavens, while demons conspire to cast them into the fiery depths of hell. Battle in monumental, church-like chambers, where the earthly floor signifies sin and the heavenly heights embody the divine. Harness the power of a pulsar engine to leap skyward and navigate the celestial battlefield with the grace of wings. Switch effortlessly between first and third-person views as you engage in pulse-pounding combat.

Armed with state-of-the-art weaponry and explosives, immerse yourself in a dazzling display of special effects that bring the ancient struggle to life. Master diverse combat scenarios, each demanding unwavering resolve and tactical brilliance. In "In Between Heavens and Earth," the fate of mankind hangs in the balance – will you rise as a guardian angel, or embrace the darkness as a harbinger of chaos?

Key Features

  • Immersive multiplayer shooter set in a timeless conflict between good and evil

  • Advanced AI embodying the roles of biblical angels and demons

  • Fight for the souls of humanity stored within enigmatic crystals

  • Majestic battlegrounds featuring cathedral-like chambers

  • Gravity-defying flight with pulsar engines and celestial wings

  • Seamless switching between first and third-person perspectives

  • Modern weapons, explosives, and visually stunning special effects

  • Engaging and diverse combat scenarios for endless excitement

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz P4, Dual Core 2.0, or AMD64X2 (or higher)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128 MB video card (supporting Pixel Shader 2.0b, such as an ATI Radeon X800 or NVIDIA GeForce 7600)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Enter a battle for the ages in 'In Between Heavens and Earth,' a multiplayer shooter where AI has taken on the roles of biblical angels and demons, fighting for human souls. Jump, fly, and fight your way through church-like tombs, armed with modern weapons and special abilities.
